svg.text: ARS + BGP NVA Dual-Hub Failover (1.C) vs. Single-Hub BGP Split (3.A / 3.B)
Pattern 1.C: Dual Hubs + ARS + BGP NVAs
Learns local C1 + NVA backup routes
Learns local C2 + NVA backup routes
Pattern 1.C ARS Mechanics & GA Route Maps Rules:
- ARS Default Routing Preference = ExpressRoute: Hub 1 prefers ER GW 1 (C1) over NVA 1 backup routes.
- Failback Rule: Prepend public 2-byte ASNs (e.g., 15010) on NVA backup routes for deterministic failback!
- ARS GA Route Maps work on NVA BGP peerings & local ER GW, NOT on hub-to-hub VNet links w/ dual ARS.
- Supports identical on-premises IPs across both domains with full stateful NVA inspection.
Single Shared Hub VNet (ONE Routing Domain!)
Connected to BOTH C1 and C2 simultaneously
Cannot route same destination IP differently per spoke!
Why Single Standard Hub Fails for Shared On-Premises Subnets:
1. Shared Services Reality: Both Prod (VNet 1) and Non-Prod (VNet 2) almost always reach shared
on-premises Active Directory, DNS, PKI, monitoring, or mainframe subnets.
2. Single FIB Limitation: One Standard Hub ER Gateway has ONE route table. For any shared prefix,
it either ECMPs both VNets across C1+C2 or sends BOTH VNets over one circuit!
3. Public ASN & Community Rules: MSEE strips private ASNs (64512-65534); VNet BgpCommunities
(12076:20xxx) do not work on vWAN; Azure ignores inbound communities sent from on-premises.
-> Need shared On-Prem IPs + full GA support? Deploy Pattern 1.D (Dual Virtual WAN Hubs)!
eBGP / iBGP Control Plane & Prefix Policy
Custom VNet BGP Tag: 12076:20xxx | Regional Private Tag: 12076:50xxx
